name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for a new room addition?
description: When choosing a contractor, consider their experience, licensing, insurance, communication, and familiarity with local building codes and permitting.

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for a new room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a new room addition, prioritize experience with similar projects, valid licensing and insurance, and a strong portfolio of completed work. It's also important to assess their communication style, ability to adhere to schedules and budgets, and references from previous clients. For projects in areas like Berkeley or Oakland, ensure the contractor is familiar with local building codes and permitting processes to prevent delays or complications.
